## Reading Order (Recommended)

1. Start with **01-PRODUCT-BRIEF** — understand the idea and problem in 5 minutes
2. Read **02-PRFAQ** — understand it from customer and stakeholder perspectives
3. Read **03-PRD** — full requirements, personas, AI system, risks, and open questions
4. Review **04-UX-DESIGN** — understand what the product looks and feels like
5. Review **05-ARCHITECTURE** — understand how it is built technically
6. Review **06-EPICS-AND-STORIES** — understand what gets built in what order
7. Review **07-SPRINT-PLAN** — understand when it gets built and what done looks like
